resources.comments: Logic app that handles approval of new provisioning requests. Replaces the former Power Automate flow 'Provisioning Request Approval'.
resources.name: ProcessApprovalRequest

Initialize_ApproverEmail_variable.description: Email/UPN of an approver or Microsoft 365 Group to approve requests.

Initialize_DisableApprovalNotifications_.description: Kept for settings compatibility. The setting controlled Power Automate Approvals push notifications and has no effect in the Logic App.

variables.name: ApprovedCard
RejectedCard

Loop_through_Members.description: Loop through the Member users and build a string to use in the submitted email.

Loop_through_Owners.description: Loop through the Owner users and build a string to use in the submitted email.

body.Subject: Provision Assist - Request Submitted
body.Body:
Request Submitted

Provision Assist
Request Submitted - @{triggerBody()?['SpaceDisplayName']}

Your request for an @{triggerBody()?['SpaceType']?['Value']} - '@{triggerBody()?['SpaceDisplayName']}' has been submitted for approval.

A summary of your request can be found below.

Title @{triggerBody()?['SpaceDisplayName']}
Type @{triggerBody()?['SpaceType']?['Value']}
URL @{triggerBody()?['SiteURL']}
Description @{triggerBody()?['Description']}
Business Justification @{triggerBody()?['BusinessJustification']}
Owners @{variables('Owners')}
Members @{variables('Members')}
Confidential data @{if(equals(triggerBody()?['ConfidentialData'],true),'Yes','No')}
Classification @{triggerBody()?['Classification']}
Visibility @{triggerBody()?['Visibility']?['Value']}
External Sharing Required @{if(equals(triggerBody()?['ExternalSharing'],true),'Yes','No')}
External Sharing Justification @{triggerBody()?['ExternalSharingJustification']}
Guests @{triggerBody()?['Guests']}
Template @{If(equals(triggerBody()?['SpaceType']?['Value'],'Microsoft Teams Team'),triggerBody()?['TeamsTemplateTitle'],triggerBody()?['SiteTemplateTitle'])}
Join Hub Site @{if(equals(triggerBody()?['JoinHub'],true),'Yes','No')}
Hub Site @{triggerBody()?['HubSiteTitle']}
Sent from Microsoft Flow - do not reply

Get the Flow app to receive push notifications and grant approvals from anywhere. Learn More

Set_RequiresApproval_variable_-_default.description: EnablePublicSpaceApprovalOnly setting is off so we always require approval.

Set_Approver_-_from_teams.description: Best effort: record who responded in the Approver person column. A failure here (e.g. the responder cannot be resolved on the site) must not fail the approval itself.

Compose_approver_list.description: Business unit approvers take precedence over the ApproverEmail setting, exactly as in the previous Power Automate flow.

Message.Subject: Please approve Space Request - '@{triggerBody()?['Title']}'
Message.Body:
Please approve or reject the following space request using the options in this email.

Title: @{triggerBody()?['SpaceDisplayName']}
Requested by: @{body('Update_status_to_Pending_Approval')?['Author']?['DisplayName']}
Requested on: @{formatDateTime(triggerBody()?['Created'], 'dd/MM/yyyy')}
Type: @{triggerBody()?['SpaceType']?['Value']}
Description: @{triggerBody()?['Description']}
Business Justification: @{triggerBody()?['BusinessJustification']}
Confidential data: @{if(equals(triggerBody()?['ConfidentialData'], true), 'Yes', 'No')}
External Sharing: @{if(equals(triggerBody()?['ExternalSharing'], true), 'Yes', 'No')}
External Sharing Justification: @{triggerBody()?['ExternalSharingJustification']}

Click here to view the full details of the request.

Check_if_reminder_emails_are_enabled.description: Runs in parallel with Send_approval_email and nudges the approvers every ApprovalReminderInterval days until a response arrives. The Terminate actions on the main chain stop this loop once the request is resolved.

Compose_responder_email.description: UserEmailAddress is only populated when the approver responds through the actionable message buttons; it can be empty for link-based responses.

Set_Approver_-_from_approval.description: Best effort: record who responded in the Approver person column. A failure here must not fail the approval itself.
